text_blocks.snippet: Morpeko ex is a Darkness-type Basic Pokémon card featuring 180 HP from the Mega Evolution: Pitch Black expansion. You can view details, stats, and pricing via Limitless TCG or PriceCharting.
snippet_highlighted_words: Darkness-type Basic Pokémon card featuring 180 HP from the Mega Evolution: Pitch Black expansion

list.snippet: HP & Type: 180 HP, Darkness-type, Basic Pokémon.
Weakness / Resistance / Retreat: Weak to Fighting types (Gx2), no resistance, retreat cost of 1 Colorless energy.
Wheely Draw [D]: Shuffles your hand into your deck and draws 6 cards.
Hangry Blaster [DD]: Deals 40 base damage plus 40 more damage for each damage counter on this Morpeko ex (scaling up to massive one-hit knockout damage).
Double Rare (#055/084): The standard holo version, typically priced around $0.50 to $4.00 depending on the vendor.
Ultra Rare / Special Illustration Rare (#117/084 or #102/084): Higher-rarity collectible art variants (such as the SIR illustrated by NC Empire) generally command between $65.00 and $115.00.
You can check current single card availability on TCGplayer.

Opinions are mixed on Reddit, with some collectors noting that the Special Illustration Rare has experienced an unusual early price bounce compared to typical post-release drops, while others view it as standard set volatility.
